# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are generally applied to the latest release line of
Fisherman's Coast for the actively maintained Minecraft targets:

- Minecraft 1.20.1 (Fabric, Forge)
- Minecraft 1.21.1 (Fabric, NeoForge)
- Minecraft 26.2 (Fabric, NeoForge)
- Minecraft 26.3 (Fabric, NeoForge)

Older releases, and Minecraft versions or loaders not listed here, do not receive fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security issues privately through GitHub Security Advisories for this repository:

https://github.com/MeherBenSalem/the-fisherman-house/security/advisories/new

Do not open a public issue or pull request that discloses an exploit before maintainers have had a chance to investigate and release a fix.
